verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows plan-based event-volume caps (honeycomb-docs-29) and retention-period behavior for SLOs (honeycomb-docs-22), but contains no documentation of developer-controllable sampling mechanisms (e.g., head/tail sampling, dynamic sampling rules) or explicit retention-tier configuration options a developer can set. Community comments (honeycomb-comm-1, honeycomb-comm-2) even highlight unmanaged data volume/cost concerns rather than confirming sampling controls. Missing for 10: documentation of sampling configuration APIs/UI, evidence of retention tier selection by users, and any hands-on confirmation of deliberate data-volume management.
